mapper.select: SELECT MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO , MR.MDEXMN_DGNSS_NM , MR.MDEXMN_MDLRT , MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_DT , PD.DRUG_NM , ( SELECT A.ATCH_FLPTH FROM atch A WHERE A.ATCH_CODE = P.ATCH_CODE ) AS prscrptnAtchCode FROM mdexmn_rcord MR LEFT OUTER JOIN prscrptn P ON P.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO = MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN prscrptn_drug PD ON PD.PRSCRPTN_NO = P.PRSCRPTN_NO WHERE MR.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} AND MR.MDEXMN_TY ='CLNIC' ORDER BY MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_DT DESC

SELECT H.id , H.dutyName , MH.HSPTL_DRCTR , MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_DT , MR.MDEXMN_RCORD_NO FROM hsptl H LEFT OUTER JOIN mdexmn_rcord MR ON H.id = MR.HSPTL_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn C ON C.CHLDRN_NO = MR.CHLDRN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN mber_chldrn MC ON MC.CHLDRN_NO = C.CHLDRN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN mber_hsptl MH ON MH.HSPTL_NO = MH.HSPTL_NO WHERE C.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo}
